items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Cee Pee C.P. Johnson, he played tom-toms, bongos and tom-toms and was a very good entertainer... We were -- all the guys in the band sang. We did things together.

ctx.x: (Inaudible). I remember that; that was in the '40s.

Yeah. And my brother played trumpet, Ernie Royal. Had another guy called Red Mack (PHONETIC). He was a very good trumpet player. And let's see, Alton Redd (PHONETIC) was the drummer and Bernard Banks (PHONETIC) was -- Ulysses Banks was the other saxophone player. And Johnny Miller (PHONETIC) was the bass player that went with the King Cole Trio and that's about it. Cee Pee C.P.
